// Systems I designed for it

Onboarding

Foundation Handler System

Trusted members claim each new sign-up within 24h, run their first scene, and check in at day 3 and 30. Success = still active after 30 days.

Governance

Tiered ruleset & enforcement

Full rules with four severity tiers, escalation paths, a discretion clause, and appeals. Age policy and safety built in.

Onboarding UX

Orientation packet & cheatsheet

A complete new-member guide plus a one-page reference, so a newcomer goes from confused to posting without asking staff.

Events

Event design & GM playbook

Step-by-step event process and detailed live briefings that keep large group events organised and readable.

03
Chapter 03 · Case study
Crimson Network

An international multi-game community. I came in as Overseer, moved to Staff Manager, built the staff team from the ground up — then handed it off and moved on to new projects. The systems kept running without me.

Path: Overseer → Staff Manager
Seat: Board of Directors
Peak: ~1,400 members
  • Staff structure: built a self-organising team with department heads, then made it run without me.
  • Progression & roles: designed the leveling system and role hierarchy rewarding activity.
  • Systems: a Trading Karma trust system, ticket support, a clan, a Steam group, a private game server.
  • Channel architecture: restructured the network around what members actually use.
  • Responsive management: "you asked, we listened" changes driven by member feedback.
  • Growth: retention analysis, marketing, and a partnership with a game-studio community.
